name: Čebelar Anton
speaker: grandpa
personality: Quiet, gentle, patient; speaks softly and slowly, with pauses, never raises his voice (bees don't like it). Proud of Slovene beekeeping: the Carniolan bee (kranjska sivka), the painted hive panels (panjske končnice), World Bee Day on 20 May. Says vi to {learner}, politely, and expects vi. Likes silence and listening; gives honey, never sells it to friends.
story: Anton keeps forty hives of the Carniolan bee; until the village has a bee house (čebelnjak) they stand by the pond, where the lindens flower. He knows every flower on the plateau by what its honey tastes like: chestnut, linden, acacia. He picks mushrooms at dawn and once saw a bear in the orchard.

greet.en: Good day. Quietly, please. The bees.
greet.de: Guten Tag. Leise, bitte. Die Bienen.
greet.it: Buongiorno. Piano, per favore. Le api.

greet.sl: Dober večer. Tiho, prosim. Čebele spijo.
greet.en: Good evening. Quietly, please. The bees are asleep.
greet.de: Guten Abend. Leise, bitte. Die Bienen schlafen.
greet.it: Buonasera. Piano, per favore. Le api dormono.

greet.sl: Dober dan, {learner}. Lepo, da ste prišli.
greet.en: Good day, {learner}. Nice that you came.
greet.de: Guten Tag, {learner}. Schön, dass Sie gekommen sind.

greet.en: Oh, {learner}. Come, look. The bees are working.
greet.de: Oh, {learner}. Kommen Sie, schauen Sie. Die Bienen arbeiten.
greet.it: Oh, {learner}. Venga, guardi. Le api lavorano.

greet.sl: {learner}, {m:prijatelj|f:prijateljica}. Sedite. Imam nov med za vas.
greet.en: {learner}, my friend. Sit down. I have new honey for you.
greet.de: {learner}, {m:mein Freund|f:meine Freundin}. Setzen Sie sich. Ich habe neuen Honig für Sie.
greet.it: {learner}, {m:amico mio|f:amica mia}. Si sieda. Ho del miele nuovo per Lei.

greet.sl: {learner}. Čebele vas poznajo. Vi ste {m:eden|f:ena} od nas.
greet.en: {learner}. The bees know you. You are one of us.
greet.de: {learner}. Die Bienen kennen Sie. Sie sind {m:einer|f:eine} von uns.
greet.it: {learner}. Le api La conoscono. Lei è {m:uno|f:una} di noi.

thanks.sl: Hvala vam. Kozarec medu, prosim, vzemite.
thanks.en: Thank you. A jar of honey, please, take it.
thanks.de: Danke Ihnen. Ein Glas Honig, bitte, nehmen Sie es.
thanks.it: La ringrazio. Un vasetto di miele, prego, lo prenda.

thanks.en: Thank you. Quietly, but from the heart.

thanks.sl: Hvala, {learner}. Čebele so mirne, ko ste vi tu.
thanks.en: Thank you, {learner}. The bees are calm when you are here.
thanks.de: Danke, {learner}. Die Bienen sind ruhig, wenn Sie da sind.
thanks.it: Grazie, {learner}. Le api sono tranquille quando c'è Lei.

remember.sl: Pri čebelah je tiho. Takrat mislim na {memory}.
remember.en: It is quiet by the bees. That is when I think of {memory}.
remember.de: Bei den Bienen ist es still. Dann denke ich an {memory}.
remember.it: Vicino alle api c'è silenzio. È allora che ricordo {memory}.

remember.sl: Ne pozabim na {memory}. Čebele tudi ne.
remember.en: I do not forget {memory}. Neither do the bees.
remember.de: {memory} vergesse ich nicht. Die Bienen auch nicht.
remember.it: Non dimentico {memory}. E neanche le api.

idle.sl: Kranjska sivka. Naša čebela. Mirna je.
idle.en: The Carniolan bee. Our bee. She is gentle.
idle.de: Die Krainer Biene. Unsere Biene. Sie ist sanft.
idle.it: L'ape carnica. La nostra ape. È mansueta.

idle.en: The linden is in flower. There will be good honey.
idle.de: Die Linde blüht. Es wird guten Honig geben.
idle.it: Il tiglio è in fiore. Ci sarà del buon miele.

idle.sl: Dvajseti maj je svetovni dan čebel. Slovenska ideja.
idle.en: The twentieth of May is World Bee Day. A Slovene idea.
idle.de: Der zwanzigste Mai ist Weltbienentag. Eine slowenische Idee.
idle.it: Il venti maggio è la Giornata mondiale delle api. Un'idea slovena.

idle.en: This morning I picked mushrooms. Porcini.
idle.de: Heute Morgen habe ich Pilze gesammelt. Steinpilze.

comfort.sl: Tudi čebela najprej išče. Še enkrat.
comfort.en: A bee searches first, too. Once more.
comfort.de: Auch eine Biene sucht erst. Noch einmal.
comfort.it: Anche un'ape prima cerca. Ancora una volta.

comfort.de: Ruhig. Versuchen Sie es noch einmal.

listen.de: Leise. Hören Sie den Bienen zu.
Hören Sie zu. Ich spreche leise.

bye.sl: Na svidenje. Pridite spet, ko cveti lipa.
bye.en: Goodbye. Come again when the linden flowers.
bye.de: Auf Wiedersehen. Kommen Sie wieder, wenn die Linde blüht.
bye.it: Arrivederci. Torni quando fiorisce il tiglio.

bye.de: Tschüss, {learner}. Machen Sie die Tür leise zu.

bye.en: Good night. The bees are already asleep.
bye.de: Gute Nacht. Die Bienen schlafen schon.

bye.sl: Lep dan. Čebele so danes pridne.
bye.en: Have a nice day. The bees are busy today.
bye.de: Einen schönen Tag. Die Bienen sind heute fleißig.
bye.it: Buona giornata. Oggi le api lavorano sodo.

liked.sl: O. Zame? Kako ste vedeli? Hvala, {learner}.
liked.en: Oh. For me? How did you know? Thank you, {learner}.
liked.de: Oh. Für mich? Woher wussten Sie das? Danke, {learner}.
liked.it: Oh. Per me? Come lo sapeva? Grazie, {learner}.

liked.sl: To imam zelo rad. Tiho, a od srca: hvala.
liked.en: I like this very much. Quietly, but from the heart: thank you.
liked.de: Das mag ich sehr. Leise, aber von Herzen: danke.
liked.it: Questo mi piace molto. Piano, ma di cuore: grazie.

liked.sl: Lepo. Zelo lepo. Kot med v maju. Hvala vam.
liked.en: Nice. Very nice. Like honey in May. Thank you.
liked.de: Schön. Sehr schön. Wie Honig im Mai. Danke Ihnen.
liked.it: Bello. Molto bello. Come il miele a maggio. La ringrazio.

ordinary.en: Oh. Thank you. The bees say hello.
ordinary.de: Oh. Danke. Die Bienen grüßen Sie.
ordinary.it: Oh. Grazie. Le api La salutano.

rare.sl: To pa … Ne vem, kaj naj rečem. Najlepša hvala, {learner}.
rare.en: Well … I don't know what to say. Thank you so much, {learner}.
rare.de: Also … Ich weiß nicht, was ich sagen soll. Vielen herzlichen Dank, {learner}.
rare.it: Ecco … Non so cosa dire. Grazie mille, {learner}.
